### Fixed
- **The Substrate worker image follows the chart's Substrate pin, never the kagent build's stamp** (giantswarm/agent-platform#466). The meta chart pins Substrate and kagent as two independent ranges, and every kagent build stamps into its chart the `ateom-gvisor` worker of the Substrate it was published against; chart 4.15.2's open kagent range (`>=0.11.0-gs.12 <0.11.1-0`) admitted kagent `0.11.0-gs.14`, which stamped a `0.0.30-gs.1` worker under the chart's `0.0.27-gs.9` atelet — Substrate 0.0.30 had renamed the pause bundle (`bundles/pause` → `bundles/_pause`), so every golden boot failed with `reading …/bundles/_pause/config.json: no such file or directory`, every AgentTemplate stayed `Ready=False … compiling`, and nothing on any hop named the skew (seen on a fresh agentlab on the default chart, giantswarm/agentlab#187; 4.15.5 re-pinned both ranges by hand). The chart now **derives `kagent.substrateWorkerPool.workerImage`** for the kagent release from `components.substrate.versionRange`'s floor — `<substrate.image.registry>/ateom-gvisor:<floor>` (`agent-platform.substrate.workerImage`, over the forwarded block like the other derived values) — so the atelet the substrate release installs and the worker the WorkerPool runs are one Substrate release whatever kagent build the kagent range admits; the same 4.15.2 shape now forwards the `0.0.27-gs.9` worker. An installation's own `workerImage` stands while its tag is the pinned release (a mirror by another path; `substrate.image.registry` moves the derived image on its own) and fails the render otherwise, naming the key, the release and the derived image. **The Substrate range must confine one release** (`agent-platform.substrate.validateRange`): an exact version or `>=X.Y.Z-gs.N <X.Y.(Z+1)-0` — the worker follows the floor and the atelet what Flux resolves, so a later `gs.N` of the pinned release may reach the control plane ahead of the worker and a `0.0.31` never; `0.x`, `~`, `^`, a `<=` ceiling or a floor alone fail the render naming the range. `make verify-worker-image` (`tests/verify-worker-image.py`) holds the derivation, the mirror, the own-value rule, the 4.15.2 shape, the exact pin, the range guards, and — against the kagent chart the range resolves to — the rendered WorkerPool's `spec.workerImage` and that the build was published against the pinned release's X.Y.Z (its `Chart.yaml` `substrate` dependency), so the meta chart's CI names the day the kagent line moves to another Substrate before the chart's pin does; `verify-components` asserts the forwarded image, `verify-workerpool` the range guard's precedence. **`components.substrate` / `components.substrate-crds` move to `>=0.0.30-gs.4 <0.0.31-0`** (the bounded golden boot, giantswarm/substrate#39, giantswarm/giantswarm#37801): the worker the fleet already runs through kagent `0.11.0-gs.20`'s stamp, so an installation following the current chart sees the WorkerPool's `spec.workerImage` unchanged and the pool does not roll; the BOM pins it. Not taken: a kagent minor bump on every Substrate-line change (a convention every `<0.11.1-0` range in the wild depends on, nothing in the chart holds it) and reading the resolved Substrate version at render time (Flux resolves after the render; the floor is the one version the chart knows, and the ceiling guard is what makes it the runtime's).
